approved_by: Claude, under Mark's delegation of 2026-10-05, after Stage 56's results and before any NHL pick was saved.

forward_test.starts: With the first pick the scheduled daily run saves. Games before it are never scored, and nothing is backfilled.
forward_test.picks: One file per game, predictions/nhl/2026/<game_id>.json, saved by the last scheduled run before the game starts and never rewritten (src/sports/nhl/lock.py, src/sports/nhl/daily.py).
forward_test.the_pick: Model B's side when the game has a market price, Model A's otherwise, as on the NFL board.
forward_test.graded: Final games only. A cancelled game is never counted; a postponed one is scored if a saved pick exists for the game the league played.
forward_test.reported: Model A, Model B, the market and the home-win base rate, by log loss with Brier beside it; accuracy is reported and never decides. Intervals as in Stage 56: paired, resampling game days, 5,000 resamples.

decision.when: Once, on the forward-test file (results/nhl/forward_2026.json) the first scheduled daily run writes after the 2026 regular season's last game is final. No earlier look decides anything; the figures before then are reported on the checks page and are not a verdict.
decision.what: Each of the three comparisons the file carries -- Model A minus the base rate, Model B minus Model A, Model B minus the market -- on log loss per game, paired on the games both scored, resampling whole game days 5,000 times with the backtest's seed.
decision.rule: The backtests' rule at their level, 1 - 0.05/3 (98.33%): ACCEPT when the whole interval is below zero (the first forecaster did better), REJECT when it is above zero, INCONCLUSIVE otherwise.

drift.baseline: Model A's log loss on Stage 56's confirmation seasons (experiments/nhl/stage56/results/confirmation.json).
drift.rule: Flag when the lower end of a one-sided 95% bootstrap interval of mean per-game log loss is above the baseline, once 100 games are graded (the NFL's rule from Stage 33 R4, with 100 games in place of 30 because the NHL grades 6 to 15 games a day).
drift.known_break: The backtest rated each game with its actual starting goalie; a live pick uses the projected one. M2 of Stage 56 measures that gap.

measurements: Stage 56 M2: the projected starter against the actual one, printed once 50 games are graded.

amendments.by: Claude, under Mark's approval of 2026-11-02 (the 2026-11-02 review, Stage 84 item 3: amendments disclosed)
amendments.seen: Written on 2026-11-03, after the forward test's first figures were computed and read: 180 graded NHL picks through 2026-11-02, with Model A minus the base rate -0.0305 [-0.0632, +0.0054], Model B minus Model A -0.0159 [-0.0352, +0.0047] and Model B minus the market -0.0070 [-0.0133, +0.0008] (log loss per game, 98.33% intervals). The rule was written knowing these, so it was kept to the backtests' own rule and level, and it decides only when it is applied.
amendments.change: Added forward_test.decision: when the season's verdict is taken, on what, and by which rule. The registration had said what is reported and not how it is judged.

amendments.by: Claude, under Mark's approval of 2026-11-02 (the 2026-11-02 review, Stage 85 item 4)
amendments.seen: Found on 2026-11-03 by comparing each saved pick's training_through with its slate: 29 of 183 saved NHL picks, on 5 slate day(s) (2026-10-10, 2026-10-12, 2026-10-17, 2026-10-24, 2026-10-31), had models fitted on games finished earlier that same day. The 26 picks on slates 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-09 were saved before picks recorded training_through, so whether their fits included same-day games cannot be checked from the files.
amendments.change: No rule changes. The live models are refitted at every run on games strictly before the pick's slate day, as the backtest's walk-forward fits them. Until this date one fit on every final game served the whole run, so a run after the day's first games fitted on them before picking that day's later ones. The ratings and features were always computed from games before the day; only the models' coefficients saw the extra games, a handful among thousands. A saved pick is never rewritten, so these stay in the forward test as saved, listed here. From this date src/sports/nhl/daily.py fit_before fits on games strictly before each slate day, and a test holds every later pick's training_through to before its slate.

amendments.by: Claude, under Mark's approval of 2026-11-02 (the 2026-11-02 review, Stage 85 item 5)
amendments.seen: Written after the forward test's first figures were read (see the forward_test.decision amendment). Found by reading the daily run: every game of this season reached the training table with no market price, so Model B, which is fitted on priced games, was fitted on earlier seasons only.
amendments.change: From 2026-11-04, each of this season's final games enters the training table with the price the daily runs recorded for it in data/nhl/lines/2026.json, the last read before it started (src/core/season_prices.py). Model B is then fitted on them as on every earlier priced game, as the registered refit on every final game says. Model A does not read the price and is unchanged. Saved picks are never rewritten; picks from this date on use the refit.
